pairs.subject: model-composed-workspace
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/studio/_view/Card.tsx:68 While the outside agent works on an ask, the pending card shows a generic 'working on this' line over a breathing skeleton instead of the real steps. The turn protocol only has say/turn events (packages/domain/src/audio.studio.events.ts), so there are no steps to narrate, and the person cannot see what the agent is reading or building before the answer lands.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/studio/_view/Card.tsx:68 The ask is acknowledged at once: the pending card echoes it with its number. The narration is the 'thinking only' form the decision rule names, and no step events exist to replace it.

app/(studio)/audio/studio/_view/registry.tsx:24 Model nodes land in declared card places, not coordinates. The rail and next-steps chrome is fixed. Each kind has its own Absent state (line 30) and a contained error state (line 59). Not verified: whether the figures in track/measures nodes (bpm, key, measure values) come from a tool or are typed by the model.

app/(studio)/audio/studio/_view/Card.tsx:218 What the door dropped is disclosed on the answer. Model changes only append a card and never move earlier ones. Agent-bound actions are proposals, and Side.tsx:126 says what pressing each one does. Stop/restore of an in-flight turn is not in this view, but turns arrive whole.

app/(studio)/audio/studio/_view/Track.tsx:63 Model content carries a worded provenance tag rather than an icon, shown only when the node supplies a source. The scroll to a new card respects reduced motion (View.tsx:34). Reveal and reserve do not apply because turns render whole.

pairs.registryProposal: conductor-turn-flow assumes the surface sees the model's steps. When the composer is an outside agent reached over an inbox/MCP (out-of-process, turn-granular protocol), the technique should say whether the deviation lives in the protocol (no step events) or the view, and whether 'acknowledgement only' is then the conformant form.
